description: Unified geospatial data quality audit for GIS data packages. Checks raster, vector, table, NetCDF, and directory structure. Outputs JSON/HTML reports, issue layers, checksums, and machine-readable exit codes. Use when the user wants to validate data packages, check delivery quality, find CRS/nodata/ geometry issues, or generate QA reports.
